head.lead: It's how we test the engine. We turned it into a contest. Each piece is logic and style on Fizlet bricks. It runs live once it nears the screen and wears its size, measured on this build: still once it settles, asleep off screen, and the page always comes back. Take any made from a prompt home as one file, or make your own. By Chris Cooley ↗. Earlier factory runs wait in the archive.
head.contestHtml:
Up to 40 entries a day. The top 1 to 5 of each day are picked, and all of them are posted at the end of the week. Then a weekly winner, and a monthly winner. The voters: the studio crew, Frame Zero, DJ Mempool, Hex Hazel, Quill, Pip and Chris Cooley. When a day has too few entries, the team backfills it with its own pieces. Over 10,240 B live, a piece goes in the Hi-Fi lane, with a weekly winner of its own.

Enter on GitHub ↗Contest rules
